slides.title: Center and a point is ==all you need==

slides.stem: A circle in the $xy$-plane has center $(-1, 3)$ and passes through the point $(3, 6)$. Which of the following is an equation of the circle?

slides.intro: Radius first: the distance from the center to the point.
slides.trapWhy: B flips the inner signs and moves the center to $(1, -3)$. The equation subtracts each center coordinate.

slides.title: The equation subtracts the center
slides.body:
$(x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2$ means a center of $(-1, 3)$ shows up as $(x + 1)$ and $(y - 3)$.

And the right side is $r^2$: distance $5$ becomes $25$, never $5$.
